description: Gate Actions: give one agent session narrow, expiring permission. Actions are rules with {placeholders} bound by scope (e.g. "PATCH /customers/{customer}/tickets/:id" with scope {"customer":"A"}), each with an optional max and approval. Add a human approver with gate_add_approver before granting approval:true actions; without an active approver the grant is refused. Returns a run token (shown once) the agent sends as x-odile-run with its app key. Writes in a run need an Idempotency-Key. Give a write a check ("GET /bookings?idempotency_key={key}") and the agent can settle a lost answer with POST /g/<id>/_gate/recover.

check.description: For a write: the GET that finds it by key, e.g. "GET /customers/{customer}/bookings?idempotency_key={key}"; it must also be a GET action of the run

idempotent.description: With check: the API dedupes on Idempotency-Key, so a not-found write may be retried

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

app.description: The app id (app_...) this run is for

label.description: Optional: what the run is for, e.g. "triage ticket 4411"

max_calls.description: Optional: calls allowed in the whole run

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_create_run
title: Grant one agent run
